notes.title: Road Map Update #2
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41647216/5712a07710a7bcdbc8be2616d333674c10db491f.png

We have a new story writer @Juneberry ! We've finished adding all key points to the map, adding black jack, slot machines, and all other mini games to the game as well! With that we're on one of our final and main steps to finishing Pixacrea the video game!  Why would we have to mention "the video game" you may be wondering?! That's because we've also been hard at work making a collectable trading card game for everyone who may be interested!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41647216/be94b3c9cce72c9a9b07fa5788e457c74662389d.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41647216/268facc1eb105f9c254c1962391c754f84a5ef15.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41647216/e27dd8ac2b2af3101095a52c9209ea64b9abf6e6.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41647216/5eaa2cbefc959b02635c3151ae86cf5dda346f35.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41647216/80b0bb9efb64698095d0f84a70044f0d63672db5.png


You can find all other information on our Website  or Join our Guilded Server!
